form.label: Health & Splunk
form.description: Can you still see everything, and is Splunk itself (a scored service) safe?

html.p: Edit the list in Settings, Advanced search, Search macros, expected_hosts.

search.query: | `expected_hosts` | join type=left host [| tstats max(_time) as last where index=* by host | eval host=lower(host)] | eval status=case(isnull(last),"NEVER SEEN", last<relative_time(now(),"-10m"),"QUIET", true(),"OK"), last_seen=if(isnull(last),"-",strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) | table host status last_seen | sort status

html.p: Severity 5. A host on the expected_hosts list sent nothing for 10 minutes. Playbook steps (page 18)

search.query: | `expected_hosts` | join type=left host [| tstats max(_time) as last where index=* by host | eval host=lower(host)] | eval minutes_quiet=if(isnull(last), "never seen", round((now()-last)/60)) | where isnull(last) OR last < relative_time(now(), "-10m") | table host minutes_quiet

panel.title: Last data per host and log

search.query: | tstats count max(_time) as last where index=* by host sourcetype | eval last=strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort host sourcetype
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=tcpin_connections | stats latest(_time) as last by hostname sourceIp | eval last=strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

html.p: The trial license allows 500 MB a day.

search.query: index=_internal source=*license_usage.log type=Usage earliest=@d | stats sum(b) as bytes by h st | eval MB=round(bytes/1024/1024,1) | fields - bytes | rename h as host, st as sourcetype | sort - MB

html.p: Severity 4. Someone failed to log into Splunk. Playbook steps (page 18)

search.query: `splunk_audit` action="login attempt" info=failed | stats count latest(_time) as last by user src | convert ctime(last) | sort - count
`splunk_audit` action="login attempt" | stats count latest(_time) as last by user info src | sort - last | convert ctime(last)

panel.title: Searches by user (find the scoring account)

html.p: The Splunk Query check logs in and searches for specific data. Never delete, rename or filter out what it looks for.

search.query: `splunk_audit` action=search info=granted user!="splunk-system-user" | stats count latest(_time) as last by user | sort - last | convert ctime(last)
`splunk_audit` action=search info=granted user!="splunk-system-user" search=* | dedup user search | table _time user search | head 30
`splunk_audit` (action=edit* OR action=create* OR action=delete* OR action=install* OR action=update*) | table _time user action info object | head 50

html.p: A new admin you didn't create is the red team.

search.query: | rest /services/authentication/users splunk_server=local | table title roles realname

html.p: A Splunk app can run commands on this box. Disable any you didn't install.

search.query: | rest /services/apps/local splunk_server=local | table title label version disabled
